purpose: Prepared事实交接的完整配对样本、计数、identity变化和测量方法；不保存源码镜像。
scope: 形成时验收记录，非当前验证、长期benchmark或可重跑SDK。historicalPath仅标注已退出的现场来源；未保存完整源码镜像、fixture、cache、原始profile。JSON/JSONL按值转存，文本原样保留；sourceSHA256识别补存时读取的原字节，不要求原路径仍存在。

materials.text:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd /workspace/vibe-check
out=tmp/optimization-wave-20261013/prepared-facts/timing.ndjson
# Exclusive creation: an earlier or partial audit record is never truncated.
(set -o noclobber; : > "$out")
cell=0
for size in 8 128 512; do
  for strategy in static custom; do
    for outputs in disabled diagnostics; do
      for cycle in 0 1; do
        # Reverse ABBA for the second cycle and alternate first-cycle order by cell.
        if (( (cell + cycle) % 2 == 0 )); then
          variants=(baseline candidate candidate baseline)
        else
          variants=(candidate baseline baseline candidate)
        fi
        slot=0
        for variant in "${variants[@]}"; do
          mise exec -- bun tmp/optimization-wave-20261013/prepared-facts/measure.ts "$variant" "$size" "$strategy" "$outputs" time "cell-${cell}-cycle-${cycle}" "$slot" >> "$out"
          slot=$((slot + 1))
        done
      done
      cell=$((cell + 1))
    done
  done
done
